basics.label: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data engineer and M.S. Data Science candidate at Texas A&M (graduating December 2026) with 15 years building and governing large-scale operational data for Indonesia's national electric utility. Ships Python and SQL ETL/ELT pipelines, standardized reporting models, and data-compliance rules over multi-year transactional datasets spanning 65 enterprises and 81 institutions.
